title: Registered Nurse – Navigator
company: The Copper River Family of Companies
description:
Coho Integrated Solutions is seeking a qualified Registered Nurse – Navigator to support referral management, discharge planning, and VA-to-DoD patient transfer coordination at the 96th Medical Group at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida.

The Registered Nurse – Navigator will serve as a clinical liaison between the 96th Medical Group and the Eglin Community-Based Outpatient Clinic, coordinating emergency department, inpatient transfers, outpatient referrals, discharge planning, and related clinical and administrative activities. The position requires extensive coordination with healthcare providers, VA personnel, TRICARE representatives, patients, families, and other members of the interdisciplinary healthcare team.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

• Serve as the primary clinical liaison between the 96th Medical Group and the Eglin Community-Based Outpatient Clinic.

• Coordinate VA-to-DoD patient transfers, emergency department transfers, inpatient placements, and outpatient referral services.

• Support safe and timely discharge planning, including coordination of durable medical equipment, home health care, specialty referrals, follow-up appointments, and community resources.

• Screen and process specialty care referrals, authorizations, Right of First Refusal (ROFR) requests, and related referral-management activities.

• Conduct medical necessity, preauthorization, medical appeal, utilization review, and insurance-related activities as required.

• Coordinate with VA providers, 96th Medical Group physicians, specialists, supervisors, receiving units, utilization management, case management, and social work personnel.

• Apply evidence-based utilization and discharge planning tools, including InterQual and Milliman guidelines, as appropriate.

• Monitor admission appropriateness, length of stay, discharge criteria, and transfer requirements to minimize avoidable delays in patient care.

• Educate patients, families, providers, and staff regarding discharge planning, referrals, transfers, post-discharge care, and available resources.

• Coordinate with third-party payers and TRICARE Managed Care Support Contractors to support authorization and reimbursement requirements.

• Maintain accurate documentation and referral-management records using MHS GENESIS and authorized VA systems.

• Participate in quality improvement initiatives, committees, working groups, training, and process improvement activities designed to improve referral and transition-of-care processes.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

• Citizenship:

• U.S. citizenship is required for this contract position

• Education and Licensure:

• Graduate of an Associate Degree in Nursing or Bachelor of Science in Nursing program from a college or university accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE).

• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification in accordance with applicable contract requirements.

• Current, active, valid, and unrestricted Registered Nurse license from any U.S. state or territory or the District of Columbia.

• Required Experience:

• Minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience.

• At least one year of experience within the last two years as a Registered Nurse in inpatient care, care coordination, discharge planning, or case management.

• Required Skill and Competencies:

• Extensive knowledge of the Military Health System or Veterans Health Administration.

• Knowledge of nursing care principles, healthcare practices, TRICARE concepts, referral management, discharge planning, and care coordination.

• Working knowledge of medical necessity, utilization review, insurance processes, and healthcare reimbursement.

• Knowledge of relevant requirements and standards affecting emergency transfers and discharge planning, including EMTALA.

• Ability to analyze clinical and administrative information and make appropriate decisions within the scope of professional nursing practice.

• Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with physicians, nurses, administrative personnel, patients, families, and external healthcare organizations.

• Proficiency with computer applications and electronic healthcare information systems.

• Work Schedule & On-Call Requirements:

• Duty hours are scheduled according to department requirements. Standard services are generally provided between 0600 and 1800, Monday through Friday, with a 40-hour workweek. Staggered schedules may be established to support mission requirements

• The Physical Therapist participates in an on-call rotation that includes Saturday and Sunday coverage from 0800–1600 once per month, as well as two federal holidays and two family days per year from 0800–1600

• Physical Requirements:

• The employee must be capable of performing the physical duties associated with professional nursing and healthcare coordination within a medical treatment facility. Duties may require standing, walking, moving throughout the facility, and interacting directly with patients and healthcare personnel. The employee must be able to perform assigned duties while maintaining patient safety, confidentiality, and professional standards.

title: Medical Receptionist

To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

Working alongside the clinical team, you will be responsible for greeting patients and visitors, completing patient registration, updating new and existing patient records, collecting payment, and ensuring patients with or without pre-existing reservations are seen in a timely manner .

This is the perfect opportunity for someone who's looking to get their foot in the door at a growing medical company or someone looking to kickstart their career in customer service or the medical field. If you enjoy working with people, staying organized, and are a pro at multi-tasking, we encourage you to apply !

• Patient Interaction: Engage with patients in a welcoming and professional manner, addressing inquiries and providing assistance both in person and over the phone.

• Welcome and greet patients to the clinic with a friendly and professional demeanor.

• Register patients efficiently, ensuring completion of all required forms with accurate information.

• Handle insurance and billing inquiries, providing clear and concise information to patients.

• Aid ill or distraught patients as necessary and with available resources .

• Payment Collection: Collect payments, insurance co-pays, and prescription charges following clinic financial policies.

• Proactively and confidently request a card on file, follow-up on patient balances, and ensure timely patient payments.

• Clinic Coordination & Collaboration: Collaborate with the healthcare team to ensure seamless patient flow and efficient clinic operations, contributing to a positive and organized environment .

• Manage patient reservations (online and walk-in) and registration, optimizing patient satisfaction and provider schedules.

• Assist in scheduling specialist referrals as needed for patient follow-up.

• Work with attention to detail in all tasks, navigating between multiple software systems to follow protocols established by our occupational health partners in support of our Employer Services team.

• Front Desk Management:

• Answer and direct phone calls in a professional and timely manner.

• Keep the reception area organized and tidy, creating a welcoming environment for patients.

• Perform various administrative duties, including photocopying, filing, and maintaining daily activity logs.

• CMD Technology & Offerings Expert:

• Become familiar with scope of services provided at CMD and costs affiliated with all services.

• Navigate and utilize various software systems for reservation scheduling and electronic medical records.

Required Availability

• Must be able to work 12-hour shifts in consecutive and or non-consecutive days:

• For full-time: Must be able to work three (3) 12-hour shifts a week with at least four (4) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday.

• For part-time: Must be able to work two (2) 12-hour shifts per week with at least two (2) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday.

• For per diem: Must be able to work four (4) 12-hour shifts per month, ideally working one (1) shift each week.

• Flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays.

• Required to travel for training shifts which will occur outside of your primary clinic within a one (1) hour commute.

Who You Are

• Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients .

• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills: Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple high-priority tasks and handle a fast-paced work environment.

• Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.

title: Software Engineer, Observability (Supercompute)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Supercompute Observability Software team owns keeping our supercompute centers running reliably at the unprecedented scale required for frontier AI training and inference by building software systems and platforms to automatically predict, monitor, and rapidly respond to changing operational conditions and incidents. Our clusters are large, heterogeneous, and always on - the team makes them observable and keeps them running: we build the infrastructure that lets engineers and technicians expedite and automate their day to day, speeding node remediation and increasing overall GPU uptime. The team partners closely with datacenter operations, AI research, and facility infrastructure teams to deliver high-impact tools that turn raw operational data into clear insight and action, ensuring true site-wide reliability and automated operation.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, build, and operate multi-service production systems (UI, APIs, data pipelines, auth, and on-call) to enable reliability, uptime monitoring, predictive alerting, upgrade/change/risk management, and site-wide impact assessments.

• Design, build, and operate predictive and analytical tools that inform better design and operations of future and current supercompute centers,

• Develop frontend visualizations, interactive dashboards, and UI components that present processed data in clear, real-time views for operators, capacity planners, and engineering stakeholders.

• Work day to day with your users, in person, to rapidly incorporate feedback and process improvements that improve GPU uptime.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Super Intelligence (SI) driven software development practices

• Programming experience in Python, Rust, C++, Java, or similar languages.

• Experience working with Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or similar database management systems.

• Proven ownership of correctness-sensitive systems - state machines, workflows, or operational data where inaccurate state has real-world impact.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or a STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional software development experience; OR 5+ years of professional software development experience in lieu of a degree.

• Experience building or operating large-scale observability, telemetry, or real-time analytics systems.

• Experience with time-series or analytical databases (Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse, InfluxDB) and streaming or high-volume telemetry pipelines.

• Experience building observability dashboards and alerting with Grafana, New Relic, Splunk, or similar.

• Frontend experience with React, Angular, or a comparable JavaScript framework, building intuitive UIs for critical operations.

• Experience operating services on cloud or on-prem infrastructure with Docker/Kubernetes in production and automated CI/CD deploys (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, etc.).

• Experience with HPC or supercomputing environments (schedulers such as Slurm, GPU/accelerator telemetry, high-speed fabrics, or parallel filesystems).

• Experience integrating with industrial/OT data sources (SCADA platforms such as Ignition, tag historians, Modbus/OPC-UA) or power/cooling infrastructure telemetry.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission-critical deadlines.

• Ability to work full-time on-site at a SpaceX office.

• Ability to travel to supercompute centers (up to 25-50% based on need).
